Both layers read Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Locke / Skill, matching the packet chart row for row, and each why states a real reason for its side. No mirror exists yet (locke__renekton not audited), so this page sets the reference.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t tells the player anti-heal is optional because Locke's sustain is 'self-refund, not lifesteal', and whys[3] claims Renekton's dash-stun 'cancels his E reset'.
audit.why: Riot's text for his W: he ignites, damages himself, and at the END of the duration heals back a portion of the damage he took during it. That refund is healing — Grievous Wounds applied before the effect expires cuts it, which makes anti-heal one of the highest-value buys in the matchup, not an optional one. On the E: the text says he teleports then dashes to attack his next target; nothing in it supports a stun cancelling a reset, so that line was replaced with the cooldown comparison that actually decides the step-up (his E is a flat 10s, Slice and Dice is 16s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says anti-heal is not optional and names the W refund; dontsFull[2].d carries the 18s W window; whys[3] replaced with the E-vs-Slice-and-Dice cooldown read.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this matchup with 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' — the page repeatedly says 'the post-E window' and 'ten seconds of nothing' without ever pinning a number to Q, W or your own tools.
audit.why: The real numbers make the advice actionable: Soul Nails 10/9/8/7/6s at 950 range, his W 18/17/16/15/14s, his E a flat 10s, his ultimate 120/100/80s at 1000 range, against Slice and Dice at 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s and Ruthless Predator at 16/14/12/10/8s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into dosFull[1].d (the 950-range 10s Q), dontsFull[1].d (his flat 10s E against your 16s dash), dontsFull[2].d (the 18s W refund) and whys[1]/whys[3].

The missing-interactions file does corroborate 'Soul Ignition' (W) and 'Ashen Pursuit' (E), which the page uses correctly.

Unverified, left on the page: breakdown.cooldowns states his E 'resets on takedowns' — nothing in Riot's text says so. Also unverified and potentially the most important interaction in the lane: the kit tags his ultimate with the 'grounding' flag (shuts off enemy dashes), which would mean Slice and Dice cannot carry you out of the zone — the description only says 'binding artifact', so I did not write it in.
